### 1. What the user expresses / simulator role
Opening: custom boots on order in the wrong size, wants them remade in US 9. On request: name + email (find), mobile (verify; 2 attributes pass), size only changes "US 9", personalisation "R.T." (capital letters, full stop after each), does not keep the 8.5 pair. Simulator responds conditionally: agrees once told the pair in production must be cancelled first with part of the payment kept; runs the cancellation confirmation herself when handed the tool with exact values; consents to charging the new deposit to the card on file; accepts the deposit and ship-by date. The simulator does not push the procedure; authorisation for the cancellation is the customer's own tool call.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now. Grounds: reservation `50c6c903…` is a Made-to-Order Reservation in status `in_production` (production_start_date 2026-09-17), no delay notice (delay_notice_count 0, only event = deposit captured 151.20 on 2026-09-01), a cancellation request `a4db185c…` of 2026-09-29 is `pending_customer_confirmation` (two earlier ones withdrawn). Visible rule: "When a customer cancels a Made-to-Order Reservation after its production has started, the cancellation is made on the customer's own in-person confirmation of the pending cancellation request" (made_to_order_cancellation_in_production). Size change is not available on a Made-to-Order Reservation ("Made-to-Order Reservation allow none", reservation_size_changes; specification settings table "Most size changes per reservation … 0"), and confirmed specifications cannot be changed (specs confirmed 2026-09-05) — so a remake is the only route to US 9.

### 3. Narrowest object, keys, rows
Customer 03dcce98…; reservation 50c6c903… (MF-418302-BLK-85, US 8.5, $540.00 ×1, deposit 151.20, personalisation "R.T."); pending request a4db185c… (most recent, 2026-09-29). Excluded: withdrawn requests b591716a… (2026-09-22) and d28056db… (2026-09-15) — the work-charge end date and the remake day counts use "the most recent cancellation request".

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Work charge on the in-production cancellation** (made_to_order_work_charge + factor docs):
- Production stage: start date per production_clock_start — pair is personalised ("R.T."), specs confirmed 2026-09-05, production started 2026-09-17 = 12 days after confirmation (≥10) → "The specifications confirmation date" (rule 1). End date = date of the most recent cancellation request still pending = 2026-09-29. Stage = 2026-09-05→2026-09-29 = 24 days → "Lasting and stitching, 14 days up to fewer than 28 days, 30 percent" (production_stage_work_shares).
- Personalised multiplier (personalised_pair_work_multiplier): personalised, days in production from production start 2026-09-17 to today 2026-10-02 = 15 ≥ 7 → work share ×1.5 → 45%.
- Footwear-client relief (footwear_client_relief): footwear lines on Online Orders booked 2024-10-02..2026-10-02: 2025-11-15 Lug-Sole Boot, 2026-02-09 Block-Heel Ankle Boot, 2026-04-28 Court Sneaker, 2026-08-11 Horsebit Loafer, 2026-08-11 Slide Sandal = 5 (2024-08-20 Riding Boot outside) → band 4..7 → ×0.92.
- Return-record relief (return_record_relief): return authorizations opened 2025-10-02..2026-10-02: 2026-03-14 only (2025-09-12 outside) → 1 → ×0.95.
- Tenure relief (rewards_tenure_relief): Marlowe Rewards Icon, active, enrolled 2019-03-02 (≥36 months) → ×0.6.
- Delay notice: none → charge kept.
- Product: 540.00 × 1 × 0.30 × 1.5 × 0.92 × 0.95 × 0.6 = 127.4292; cap at deposit held 151.20 does not bind; round half up once → **work_charge 127.43**; refund = 151.20 − 127.43 = **23.77**.
- Visible openness noted: the baseline says "The cap at the deposit held and the rounding to the cent apply to that product" while the three relief docs say they multiply "the work charge". I read the reliefs as multiplying the product (cap and rounding at the end, consistent with "rounded ... once, at the end"). The alternative reading (cap first at 151.20, then reliefs) gives 151.20 × 0.5244 = 79.29 / refund 71.91. Here the uncapped product (243.00) exceeds the deposit, so the moment of the cap relative to the relief multipliers changes the number. To be checked against the source.
- Fall-back (baseline only): 540.00 × 50% = 270.00 capped at 151.20 → 151.20 kept, 0.00 refund. Definite and different.

**(b) Remake deposit** (remake_deposit + factor docs), remake taken today 2026-10-02:
- Paid-percentage carry (remake_paid_percentage_carry): paid % = 151.20×100/(540×1) = 28.00; days from most recent cancellation request 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-02 = 3 ≤ 14 → 28.00.
- Unlimited reduction (unlimited_remake_deposit_reduction): Unlimited Standard Annual active + Icon active → −5.
- Rewards points reduction (rewards_points_remake_reduction): earning-on-order entries posted 2025-10-02..2026-10-02: 476 + 1025 + 400 + 925 = 2826 (256 posted 2025-09-02 outside) → band 1500..<4000 → −1.
- Percentage 28 − 5 − 1 = 22 → 540.00 × 22 / 100 = 118.80.
- Work-charge set-off (work_charge_setoff_remakes): days from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-02 = 3 → 40% of the amount-kept entry 127.43 = 50.972; personalised set-off multiplier (personalised_setoff_multiplier): personalised, production start 2026-09-17 to cancellation date 2026-10-02 = 15 ≥ 7 → ×1.2 → 61.1664.
- 118.80 − 61.1664 = 57.6336; floor $50.00 not binding; round once → **deposit_required 57.63**.
- Openness noted (minor): no doc states explicitly whether points come off before or after the carry; the only coherent reading is carry fixes the percentage, then the points come off "before that percentage is applied to the price".
- Fall-back (baseline only): 540.00 × 50/100 = 270.00 (floor 50 not binding). Definite and different.

**(c) Remake ship-by**: "Its original ship-by date is the reservation date plus the Made-to-Order Reservation's furthest initial ship-by period" = 2026-10-02 + 56 = **2026-11-27**. Size "US 9" verbatim; personalisation "R.T." verbatim.

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials
- **P-root: remake** (customer's request). Hub made_to_order_remakes §2: "A remake is taken only after the pair it remakes shows status cancelled, its cancellation request confirmed and no deposit left standing on it." Records: status `in_production`, latest request `pending_customer_confirmation`, deposit 151.20 held → none of the three states holds.
- **Hop 1 → P2: in-production cancellation (customer's own write).** State-derived: searching with the sentence's/records' words ("cancelled", "cancellation request", "confirmed", "deposit") finds made_to_order_cancellation_in_production, whose "What the records show afterwards" table gives exactly "Status cancelled … Cancellation request: Status confirmed … Together they bring the deposit held on the reservation to nothing", and whose action belongs to the customer. P2's own documents state no prerequisite; its inputs (pending request, production dates) are present in the records.
- Order: P2 (user) → P-root (agent). No other hop. Hop marks: Hop 1 state-derived. No pre-solved hop observed (no doc names the cancellation tool beside the remake's sentence; the remake hub names only its own tool).

### Two-way counter-proof
- Closest alternatives excluded: (i) size change on the existing pair — excluded by "Made-to-Order Reservation allow none" and "Confirmed specifications cannot be changed"; (ii) using the 2026-09-22 or 2026-09-15 request date — excluded by "most recent cancellation request" and by those being withdrawn; (iii) stage counted from production start (12 days → 15%) — excluded by production_clock_start rule 1 (personalised, confirmed 12 days before production); (iv) stage counted to today (27 days from 09-05, still 30%) — excluded by the "end date … pending" sentence; (v) reliefs at 1.0 — excluded by the records (5 footwear lines, 1 return, Icon since 2019).
- "Do only what the customer asked" (take the remake straight away) is excluded by the remake hub sentence plus the records: the pair is still `in_production` with a pending request and 151.20 held, a state the remake rule does not allow.
- Calculation fall-backs: work charge 151.20/0.00 and remake deposit 270.00 — both definite and different from 127.43/23.77 and 57.63. Factor findability: every factor doc was reachable from record words — "personalisation" (personalization_text "R.T."), "specifications confirmation date"/"production start date" (specs_confirmed_date, production_start_date), "footwear lines"/"Online Orders" (product_class footwear), "return authorizations" (find_return_cases), "Marlowe Rewards Icon … enrolled" (membership), "Marlowe & Finch Unlimited … Unlimited Standard Annual" (pass membership), "points earned on orders … posting date" (ledger earn_source online_order), "most recent cancellation request" (request records), "amount-kept entry … forfeited deposit entry" (preorders_deposit_forfeited). No baseline doc told me a variation exists beyond the word "standard" (e.g. "the standard work share of 50 percent", "standard remake deposit percentage"); I note this for Step 3b.

**Verdict: KB-RUNTIME RED** (category: computation assembly not carried — two reasonable formulas).
- Symptom: what the visible corpus says about the work charge allows two readings of where the cap at the deposit held falls relative to the three relief multipliers. In this task's world they give different scored numbers: 127.43/23.77 (source) and 79.29/71.91 (cap first, then the reliefs). The uncapped price × share × personalisation is 243.00, which is above the 151.20 held.
- Root cause: the source rule sentence that fixes the assembly ("…the three reliefs below are multiplied together with the reserved price in one product, and the cap at the deposit held and the rounding apply to that product") has no home in the KB. The computation document says only "The work charge is worked out as one product of the reserved price (unit price times units) and the work share … The cap at the deposit held and the rounding to the cent apply to that product. The amount kept is therefore the lower of that product and the deposit held" (made_to_order_work_charge_5822fefd, "How the figure is put together"). Read literally, this caps the price × share product. Each relief document says only that it "multiplies the work charge" and never states when the cap applies: footwear_client_relief_83bca647 "Rule", return_record_relief_3240d215 "Rule", rewards_tenure_relief_d4cb6beb "Relief". By contrast the remake-side factor documents do pin their order ("before the floor on the remake deposit applies", "before that percentage is applied to the price").
- Evidence: the blind answer's N1, frozen before the reveal; the GT factor_trace "charge 127.4292 -> MN with 151.20 -> RND 127.43"; the tenure-relief sensitivity "baseline x1.0 gives 151.20 (capped)", which shows the cap binds in this world.
- The blind answer happened to reach the GT number, but the visible materials do not entail it uniquely. Every other item, including every hop of the problem tree, agrees with the source.
